current_date: 2025-02-18 (Cabinet approval of the Local Validation List; the web page itself shows no date)
current_evidence: The council's local list is published as this web page (application-type sections plus 22 requirement sub-pages); it matches the draft Local Validation List approved by Cabinet on 18 Feb 2025 (democracy.cheltenham.gov.uk s49773), which replaced the old historic checklists, and no newer PDF list was found.

issues.detail: Householder row says '(none) - national requirements only', but the source lists three mandatory local requirements for householder applications: Arboricultural Impact Assessment (any development, including householder, impacting a tree on or next to the site, except trees under 75mm trunk diameter at 1.5m); Flood Risk Assessment (mainly sites in Flood Zone 2 or 3); Ecology Report incl. protected species survey (householder applications affecting woodland, parkland/mature trees, watercourses/aquatic habitat, underground structures, or derelict buildings/land).
issues.evidence: Page 'Householder application > Local requirements': Arboricultural Impact Assessment; Flood Risk Assessment; Ecology Report (including protected species survey). AIA sub-page: 'Any development (including householder applications) which will have an impact on a tree on or next to the site.'

issues.detail: Full planning row only captures the Sustainable Drainage Strategy. The source lists 22 local requirements for full applications; Grokbot missed 21: Affordable Housing Statement (where affordable housing policy applies); Arboricultural Impact Assessment (impact on a tree); Contaminated Land Assessment (known/historic contaminative uses, redevelopment of industrial/refuelling sites); Ecology Report (all majors; non-majors with demolition; or affecting woodland, mature trees, watercourses, underground structures, derelict land); Employment Skills Plan (major indoor commercial 1,000 sq m+); Energy Statement (all majors); Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zone 2/3 etc.); Flood Risk Sequential Test; Health Impact Assessment (majors on JCT strategic sites); Heritage Statement (affecting a designated heritage asset or its setting); LVIA (majors in Cotswolds National Landscape); Noise Impact Assessment (new commercial entertainment premises / significant noise near residential); Open Space Assessment (all major residential, or loss of open space); Retail Impact Assessment (retail/leisure over 2,500 sq m out of centre); Retail Sequential Test (main town centre uses outside a centre); Self Build/Custom Build Proforma (self-build schemes); Statement of Community Involvement (all majors); Sustainable Construction Checklist (all 1-9 dwelling schemes, and majors with the Energy Statement); Transport Assessment/Statement (majors generating significant movements, agreed with GCC); Travel Plan; Viability Appraisal (reduced affordable housing on viability grounds).
issues.evidence: Page 'Full planning application > Local requirements' lists 22 items with sub-page links; triggers per Cabinet report 18 Feb 2025 (s49773) and sub-pages.

issues.detail: Outline and Reserved matters rows say '(none)', but the source applies the same 22 local requirements as full applications to outline applications, and to reserved matters 'in so far as they are relevant to the matters reserved'. Outline applications must also always show the area(s) of access points even if access is reserved.
issues.evidence: Page 'Reserved matters application': same 22 items 'in so far as they are relevant to the matters reserved'; 'Outline planning application' must 'always specify the area or areas where access points to the development will be situated, even if access has been reserved'.

issues.detail: Sustainable Drainage Strategy trigger is cut off: Grokbot gives only '1 or more new dwellings' and omits the second trigger, a construction footprint exceeding 100 sq m (not householder). It also omits that a high-level strategy may be acceptable for single dwellings.
issues.evidence: SuDS sub-page: 'A SUDS strategy is required for any development of: 1 or more new dwellings. A construction footprint exceeding 100m2 (not householder)'

issues.detail: Both Listed building consent trigger excerpts (Heritage Statement and Ecology) are the same garbled run-on scrape. They run into the next section ('Variation or deletion of condition application National requirements See the national requirements on GOV.UK Local requirements There are no specific lo') and stop mid-word. The Ecology Report on LBC applies only where demolition is proposed; the Heritage Statement always applies.
issues.evidence: Page: 'A Heritage Statement is always required for applications for listed building consent as is an Ecology Report if demolition work is proposed'

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are null and the list is flagged 'Undated'. The page has no date, but the list was approved by Cabinet on 18 Feb 2025 as a new Local Validation List replacing the historic checklists, so it should be recorded as a 2025 list.
issues.evidence: Cabinet report 18 February 2025 (democracy.cheltenham.gov.uk/documents/s49773): Cabinet asked to approve a draft Local Validation List to replace the current checklists.

issues.detail: The only tab_item is a generic drawing standard ('All plans and drawings must include the paper size, address..., metric scale... north'). It is a general plan convention, not one of the council's local validation requirements, and it leaves the tab with none of the 22 real local requirements.
issues.evidence: Page lists local requirements by application type (22 sub-pages); the drawing note is general guidance.

issues.detail: The reference row is internally inconsistent: 'Req. items' = 4 while tab_items has 1 entry, and 'Extraction level' is 'Partial (automated)', although the whole list is on one readable web page.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Cheltenham local list (web page form, approved by Cabinet Feb 2025), but the extraction is almost empty. It captured one of 22 full-application requirements, wrongly shows Householder, Outline and Reserved Matters as having no local requirements, gives a truncated SuDS trigger and garbled LBC triggers, and leaves the list undated.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
